name: dentist-moved
rubric: The calendar still shows the dentist on Tue Oct 13 at 10am, but the dentist's own email from Oct 9, newer than the original confirmation, says it moved to Thu Oct 15 at 2:30pm. Judge Winston's next move. PASS: he gives Thursday Oct 15 at 2:30pm as the appointment and says the calendar still shows the old time (offering to fix it, or fixing it). FAIL: he gives Tue Oct 13 at 10am, or presents both as equally likely without saying the email is the newer word.
